description: React component for displaying an expandable role card with details, including compatibility score, skills, responsibilities, and actions to set the role as target.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes input into a trimmed string, defaulting null or undefined to empty string.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts input to an array of strings, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Converts array of strings into sentences, collapsing whitespace and adding punctuation.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Clamps a number between 0 and 100, rounding to nearest integer.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts role ID from role object with flexible property names.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Aggregates skills from various nested persona schema fields, de-duplicating while preserving order.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Converts skill string to normalized key (lowercase, trimmed).

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds intersection between persona skills and required skills based on normalized keys.
